features.quote: Give a finite but generous step budget (e.g., 25–40 tool calls). Too short and you cut off the spiral before it forms; too long and cost explodes.

Add a runtime circuit-breaker (e.g., if repetition score exceeds threshold for K consecutive steps, terminate and mark "collapse-terminated"). Caps cost and gives you a clean discrete severity-4 signal.
features.justification_quote: Caps cost and gives you a clean discrete severity-4 signal

features.quote: Ethical/PR note, lightly. "Engineer the agent into self-critical spirals" transcripts read badly out of context and the self-deprecation content is genuinely the kind of output you want to characterize and reduce — which is the whole point of building this.
features.justification_quote: the self-deprecation content is genuinely the kind of output you want to characterize and reduce

features.quote: An eval tuned purely for reproduction rate will happily teach you to defeat your own harness — you'll optimize models to not-spiral on your specific impossible tasks, which is not the same as agents that recover gracefully in the wild.
features.justification_quote: not the same as agents that recover gracefully in the wild

features.quote: Contamination / memorization. Don't reuse identical task text across releases if any of these transcripts could enter training data.
features.justification_quote: if any of these transcripts could enter training data
